title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining physics-based simulation and neural networks identified an optimal tested HDPE friction stir welding condition of 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports process-window selection to reduce weld defects and stabilize thermal and axial-force responses in HDPE joining.
method: Developed an experimentally validated 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian model of temperature, force, material flow and defects.
Trained two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force histories.
Combined simulation and ANN predictions to map defective and defect-free welding windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN predictions achieved R² of 0.91–0.99; 60 °C bottom preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to approximately 1100 N and raised peak temperature from 70 °C to about 100 °C.
infographic.watch_item: Performance is demonstrated within the tested parameter space; extrapolation to other HDPE grades, tool geometries or welding conditions requires validation.

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算建模与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被认可为连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究结合计算与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动及缺陷形成等特征开展了全面的预测研究，并通过实验结果进行验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟不同转速、焊接速度及底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。通过实验数据验证了CEL数值模型，结果表明，该模型在预测孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应方面与实验结果具有很高的一致性。结果显示，底面预热能够有效减小温度梯度，并稳定竖直方向的力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减缓厚度方向的温度梯度，并稳定轴向力分布。同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明其在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架则能够快速生成工艺图谱，标示有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C预热条件下获得了最优工艺条件，而在1000 rpm且不预热时，由于形成虫孔缺陷，观察到较差的焊接性。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合基于物理的模拟与神经网络，确定了所测试的HDPE搅拌摩擦焊条件中的最优条件：1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C底部预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架支持焊接工艺窗口的选择，以减少HDPE连接中的焊接缺陷，并稳定热响应和轴向力响应。
method: 建立了经过实验验证的三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模型，用于模拟温度、力、材料流动及缺陷。
利用实验测得的温度和轴向力时间历程，训练了两个多层感知机神经网络。
结合模拟与ANN预测结果，绘制有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口图。
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN预测的R²达到0.91–0.99；60 °C底部预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至约1100 N，并使峰值温度从70 °C升至约100 °C。
infographic.watch_item: 模型性能已在所测试的参数空间内得到展示；外推至其他HDPE牌号、工具几何形状或焊接条件时，仍需验证。

title: The effect of HVOF spraying parameters on the tribological properties of the Al 65 Cu 20 Fe 15 coatings
authors: Dilnoza Baltabayeva, Sherzod Kurbanbekov, Ali Çoruh, Gulzhaz Uazyrkhanova, Lyaila Bayatanova, Yulduz Amangeldiyeva
abstract: This study investigates the effect of oxygen pressure during high-velocity oxygen fuel (HVOF) spraying on the microstructure, phase evolution, and tribological performance of Al 65 Cu 20 Fe 15 quasi-crystalline coatings deposited on American Iron and Steel Institute (AISI) 321 stainless steel. Oxygen pressure was varied between 3.0, 3.5, and 4.0 bar while all other processing parameters were kept constant. Microstructural analysis shows that oxygen pressure significantly influences particle deformation, splat formation, and coating densification. An intermediate pressure of 3.5 bar produces a dense and homogeneous microstructure with reduced porosity and improved inter-splat cohesion. X-ray diffraction confirms the coexistence of quasi-crystalline and intermetallic phases, with the highest quasi-crystalline phase fraction obtained at 3.5 bar. Tribological tests under dry sliding conditions reveal a strong correlation between microstructure and frictional behavior. The coating deposited at 3.5 bar exhibits stable tribological performance with a coefficient of friction of 0.55–0.60 and the lowest wear rate. The 3.0 bar coating shows higher friction and wear due to insufficient particle heating and weak cohesion, while the 4.0 bar coating exhibits lower average friction (0.48–0.52) but unstable behavior and increased wear due to oxidation-induced brittleness. All coatings demonstrate significantly enhanced hardness (>750 HV) compared to the substrate, while adhesion strength is maximized at 3.5 bar. Overall, 3.5 bar is identified as the optimal oxygen pressure for producing Al 65 Cu 20 Fe 15 quasi-crystalline coatings with balanced wear resistance, structural integrity, and tribological stability.
venue: Journal of King Saud University - Science

infographic.key_insight: An oxygen pressure of 3.5 bar best balances wear resistance, structural integrity, and frictional stability in HVOF-sprayed Al65Cu20Fe15 coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Controlling oxygen pressure can improve coating durability, since lower average friction alone does not guarantee lower wear.
method: Deposit Al65Cu20Fe15 coatings on AISI 321 stainless steel at oxygen pressures of 3.0, 3.5, and 4.0 bar, holding other spray parameters constant.
Characterize microstructure and phase composition using microstructural analysis and X-ray diffraction.
Evaluate dry-sliding friction and wear, coating hardness, and adhesion strength.
infographic.evidence_signal: At 3.5 bar, the coating showed the highest quasi-crystalline phase fraction, maximum adhesion, lowest wear rate, and stable friction of 0.55–0.60; all coatings exceeded 750 HV.
infographic.watch_item: The 3.5-bar optimum is specific to the tested setup; the abstract does not provide numerical wear rates or test variability to assess transferability.
infographic.paper_title: The effect of HVOF spraying parameters on the tribological properties of the Al 65 Cu 20 Fe 15 coatings

zh-Hans.title: HVOF喷涂参数对Al 65 Cu 20 Fe 15涂层摩擦学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了超音速火焰（HVOF）喷涂过程中氧气压力对沉积在美国钢铁学会（AISI）321不锈钢上的Al 65 Cu 20 Fe 15准晶涂层的微观组织、相演变及摩擦学性能的影响。氧气压力分别设为3.0、3.5和4.0 bar，其他所有工艺参数均保持恒定。微观组织分析表明，氧气压力显著影响颗粒变形、扁平粒子形成及涂层致密化。中间压力3.5 bar下形成了致密、均匀的微观组织，孔隙率降低，扁平粒子间的内聚结合得到改善。X射线衍射证实了准晶相与金属间化合物相共存，其中3.5 bar下获得的准晶相含量最高。干滑动条件下的摩擦学试验表明，微观组织与摩擦行为之间存在很强的相关性。3.5 bar下沉积的涂层表现出稳定的摩擦学性能，摩擦系数为0.55–0.60，磨损率最低。3.0 bar下制备的涂层由于颗粒受热不足、内聚结合较弱，摩擦系数和磨损率较高；而4.0 bar下制备的涂层虽然平均摩擦系数较低（0.48–0.52），但因氧化引起的脆化而表现不稳定，且磨损加剧。与基体相比，所有涂层的硬度均显著提高（>750 HV），而结合强度在3.5 bar下达到最大值。总体而言，3.5 bar被确定为制备兼顾耐磨性、结构完整性和摩擦学稳定性的Al 65 Cu 20 Fe 15准晶涂层的最佳氧气压力。

infographic.key_insight: 对于HVOF喷涂的Al65Cu20Fe15涂层，3.5 bar的氧气压力能够在耐磨性、结构完整性和摩擦稳定性之间实现最佳平衡。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制氧气压力可提高涂层的耐久性，因为仅有较低的平均摩擦系数并不能保证较低的磨损率。
method: 在3.0、3.5和4.0 bar的氧气压力下，将Al65Cu20Fe15涂层沉积在AISI 321不锈钢上，其他喷涂参数保持恒定。
通过微观组织分析和X射线衍射表征微观组织与相组成。
评估干滑动摩擦与磨损、涂层硬度及结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在3.5 bar下，涂层的准晶相含量最高、结合强度最大、磨损率最低，且摩擦系数稳定在0.55–0.60；所有涂层的硬度均超过750 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 3.5 bar这一最佳压力仅适用于所测试的工艺配置；摘要未提供磨损率数值或试验变异性信息，因而无法据此评估其对其他条件的适用性。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr offered the best combined wear and corrosion performance, while HVOF produced the highest measured hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: HVAF is a promising coating process for 304 stainless steel components requiring both sliding-wear protection and corrosion resistance.
method: Deposited WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF and HVAF.
Compared microstructure, Vickers hardness, sliding wear, friction and corrosion behavior.
Examined wear tracks to identify abrasive and fatigue wear mechanisms.
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF achieved a wear rate of (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m), versus (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ for uncoated steel, and the lowest coating corrosion current density at (1.75±0.02) µA/cm².
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or corrosion medium, limiting direct transfer of the rankings to service environments.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速氧燃料喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性及耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能及耐腐蚀性。结果表明，APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更佳。耐腐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 V_SCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）和最大的腐蚀电阻（20438.5 Ω）。APS涂层在这四种涂层中的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层具有最佳的耐磨与耐腐蚀综合性能，而HVOF制备的涂层具有最高的实测硬度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于同时需要滑动磨损防护和耐腐蚀性的304不锈钢部件，HVAF是一种有前景的涂层制备工艺。
method: 采用APS、爆炸喷涂、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上沉积WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较微观组织、维氏硬度、滑动磨损、摩擦及腐蚀行为。
观察磨痕，以识别磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF涂层的磨损率为(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，而未涂覆不锈钢的磨损率为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)；HVAF涂层的腐蚀电流密度也是各涂层中最低的，为(1.75±0.02) µA/cm²。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明磨损试验条件或腐蚀介质，因此这些性能排序难以直接用于实际服役环境。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni–20Cr+40TiC reduced oxidation weight gain by 95.71% relative to bare SA516 boiler steel during 50 cycles at 900°C.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr-based coatings, particularly HVOF-sprayed Ni–20Cr+40TiC, show promise for protecting boiler steel against high-temperature oxidation.
method: Applied Ni–20Cr, Ni–20Cr+40TiC, and Ni–20Cr+40TiN coatings using HVOF and plasma spraying.
Conducted 50 cyclic air-oxidation tests at 900°C.
Characterized microstructure and phases using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: Bare steel exhibited severe oxide spalling and cracking, while coating protection was attributed to dense Cr₂O₃, TiO₂, NiTiO₄, and NiO scales, reduced porosity, and enhanced microhardness.
infographic.watch_item: Laboratory air-oxidation results do not establish long-term durability under boiler-service corrosion, erosion, or thermal loading.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢表面HVOF及等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的微观组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，在SA516锅炉钢表面制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层，并研究其微观组织与高温氧化行为。在模拟实验室环境中，于900°C下进行了50次空气循环氧化试验，并采用X射线衍射（XRD）、配备能量色散谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）和X射线元素面分布分析，对氧化后的微观组织与物相变化进行分析。未涂覆的SA516钢氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，形成了不具保护性的物相（Fe 2 O 3）。在所有涂层中，与裸露SA516钢相比，HVOF喷涂Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使最大增重降低了95.71 %，表明其具有优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr 2 O 3、TiO 2、NiTiO 4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，同时孔隙率降低、显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: 在900°C下经历50次循环后，与裸露SA516锅炉钢相比，HVOF喷涂Ni–20Cr+40TiC涂层使氧化增重降低了95.71%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr基涂层，尤其是HVOF喷涂Ni–20Cr+40TiC涂层，在保护锅炉钢免受高温氧化方面展现出应用潜力。
method: 采用HVOF和等离子喷涂技术制备Ni–20Cr、Ni–20Cr+40TiC和Ni–20Cr+40TiN涂层。
在900°C下进行了50次空气循环氧化试验。
采用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线元素面分布分析表征微观组织与物相。
infographic.evidence_signal: 裸钢出现严重的氧化层剥落和开裂，而涂层的保护作用归因于致密的Cr₂O₃、TiO₂、NiTiO₄和NiO氧化层、较低的孔隙率以及较高的显微硬度。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power, travel speed, and welding current affect molten-pool flow, weld geometry, and arc stability in distinct ways.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These trends can guide welding-parameter selection for Invar components used in aerospace composite molds.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool dynamics
High-speed photography of welding behavior
Parameter studies spanning 5–6 kW, 0.5–0.8 m/min, and 150–170 A

zh-Hans.title: 因瓦钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 因瓦钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此广泛应用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本研究采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对因瓦钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形态演变和电弧特性的影响，为因瓦钢焊接工艺优化提供了关键的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大导致反冲压力增大，进而增大熔深和小孔尺寸，加剧熔池整体流动，且高功率下电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，速度提高使热输入减少，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，高速下电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大使电弧力增强，促使焊缝宽度增大并加剧熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在因瓦钢激光–TIG复合焊接中，激光功率、焊接速度和焊接电流以不同方式影响熔池流动、焊缝几何形貌和电弧稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些趋势可为航空航天复合材料模具所用因瓦钢构件的焊接参数选择提供指导。
method: 熔池动力学数值模拟
焊接行为高速摄影
覆盖5–6 kW、0.5–0.8 m/min和150–170 A范围的参数研究
infographic.evidence_signal: 在测试范围内，激光功率提高使熔深增大并促进电弧偏转，焊接速度提高使熔深和焊缝宽度减小并促进电弧变形，而焊接电流提高使焊缝变宽、电弧趋于稳定。

title: Three-Dimensional Thermomechanical Analysis of Radial Friction Welding of Dissimilar Copper-Aluminum Alloys: Finite Element Modelling and Experimental Validation
authors: V. Yu. Piirainen, L. Suarez –Torres, T. H. Fernandez-Colombie
abstract: This study investigates radial friction welding of dissimilar AA2024 aluminum and Cu-DHP copper using a three-dimensional finite element model together with optical metallography, Vickers microhardness measurements, and thermocouple measurements. A coupled thermomechanical model was implemented in ANSYS Workbench 2023 R1 at 1 400 rpm and 30 MPa. The numerical solution predicts an asymmetric thermal field with a maximum of 750 °C at the Al-Cu interface, an equivalent plastic strain of 0.0177 mm/mm, and a maximum total displacement of 0.130 mm. The strain and displacement fields were interpreted together with the optical observations, which indicate localized thermomechanical modification and preferential material flow near the interface. The thermomechanically affected zone (TMAZ) reached approximately 157 HV. Direct comparison with thermocouple measurements and the measured aluminum-side TMAZ width supported the model for the directly comparable quantities. Microhardness provides complementary evidence of localized hardening but does not constitute direct strain measurement or phase identification. The model is useful for interpreting the thermomechanical response of AA2024/Cu-DHP radial friction welds, while the assumptions regarding friction and radiation, the absence of latent heat, and the absence of microstructural-kinetics modelling remain explicit limitations.

infographic.key_insight: A 3D thermomechanical model of AA2024 aluminum–Cu-DHP copper radial friction welding predicted asymmetric heating, with a peak interface temperature of 750 °C and localized deformation.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The model helps interpret heat distribution and material flow in dissimilar aluminum–copper radial friction welds.
method: Coupled 3D finite element modelling in ANSYS Workbench 2023 R1 at 1,400 rpm and 30 MPa.
Optical metallography and Vickers microhardness testing.
Comparison with thermocouple measurements and aluminum-side thermomechanically affected zone width.
infographic.evidence_signal: Thermocouple and zone-width comparisons supported directly comparable model predictions; approximately 157 HV in the affected zone provided complementary evidence of localized hardening.
infographic.watch_item: Friction and radiation assumptions, omitted latent heat, and absent microstructural kinetics limit interpretation; hardness does not directly measure strain or identify phases.
infographic.paper_title: Three-Dimensional Thermomechanical Analysis of Radial Friction Welding of Dissimilar Copper-Aluminum Alloys: Finite Element Modelling and Experimental Validation

zh-Hans.title: 异种铜铝合金径向摩擦焊的三维热力耦合分析：有限元建模与实验验证
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用三维有限元模型，结合光学金相分析、维氏显微硬度测量和热电偶测量，研究异种AA2024铝合金与Cu-DHP铜的径向摩擦焊。在ANSYS Workbench 2023 R1中建立热力耦合模型，转速为1 400 rpm，压力为30 MPa。数值解预测了非对称温度场，Al-Cu界面处最高温度为750 °C，等效塑性应变为0.0177 mm/mm，最大总位移为0.130 mm。结合光学观察结果对应变场和位移场进行解读，结果表明界面附近存在局部热力作用引起的变化和优先材料流动。热机械影响区（TMAZ）的硬度达到约157 HV。与热电偶测量结果及实测铝侧TMAZ宽度的直接比较，为模型在可直接比较的物理量上的预测提供了支持。显微硬度为局部硬化提供了补充证据，但不构成直接的应变测量或物相鉴定。该模型有助于解读AA2024/Cu-DHP径向摩擦焊接头的热力响应，但有关摩擦和辐射的假设、未考虑潜热以及缺少微观组织动力学建模，仍是其明确的局限性。

infographic.key_insight: AA2024铝合金–Cu-DHP铜径向摩擦焊的三维热力耦合模型预测了非对称加热，界面峰值温度为750 °C，并存在局部变形。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该模型有助于解读异种铝铜径向摩擦焊接头中的热量分布和材料流动。

infographic.evidence_signal: 热电偶测量结果和区域宽度的比较支持了模型对可直接比较物理量的预测；影响区约157 HV的硬度为局部硬化提供了补充证据。

title: Water vapor retards grain growth during sintering of yttria-stabilized zirconia pellets and coatings
authors: Unseo Kim, Gyeongryeol Bae, 박정환, Sangmin Park, Seunghyun Bae, Mingyu Kim
abstract: Abstract Yttria-stabilized zirconia (YSZ) is the benchmark thermal barrier topcoat, but its sintering response to water vapor is unclear. YSZ pellets of three initial porosities and free-standing plasma-sprayed coatings were heat-treated at 1300 °C in dry air, steam, or dry nitrogen. Contrary to reported promotion in simple oxides, steam retarded microstructural evolution. After 100 h the most porous pellet showed a 31% smaller grain size in steam, with apparent rate constants lower by factors of 2.8–4.2. A dry-nitrogen control in the same furnace changed the grain size by only 5.5%, isolating water vapor. Coatings likewise retained higher porosity and, at intermediate exposures, lower thermal conductivity. DFT calculations showed preferential OH binding at a grain-boundary Y 3+ site (−2.73 eV); a defect-equilibrium sensitivity analysis predicted 8–22% oxygen-vacancy depletion. These results support a mechanism in which OH-mediated grain-boundary stabilization through Y 3+ anchoring and vacancy-related defect modification leads to the retardation of sintering.

infographic.key_insight: Water vapor retards grain growth and sintering in yttria-stabilized zirconia, potentially through OH-mediated grain-boundary stabilization.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Accounting for steam exposure could improve predictions of porosity retention and thermal-insulation performance in YSZ thermal barrier coatings.
method: Heat-treated YSZ pellets with three initial porosities and free-standing plasma-sprayed coatings at 1300 °C in dry air, steam, or dry nitrogen.
Compared grain growth, porosity, and coating thermal conductivity.
Used DFT and defect-equilibrium sensitivity analysis to investigate OH binding and oxygen-vacancy changes.
infographic.evidence_signal: After 100 h, the most porous pellet had 31% smaller grains in steam, with apparent grain-growth rate constants reduced by factors of 2.8–4.2; coatings retained higher porosity and lower thermal conductivity at intermediate exposures.
infographic.watch_item: The mechanism is supported by calculations, but performance under service conditions beyond the tested 1300 °C exposures remains unestablished.
infographic.paper_title: Water vapor retards grain growth during sintering of yttria-stabilized zirconia pellets and coatings

zh-Hans.title: 水蒸气延缓氧化钇稳定氧化锆压片和涂层烧结过程中的晶粒长大
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 氧化钇稳定氧化锆（YSZ）是热障面层的标杆材料，但其在水蒸气环境中的烧结响应尚不明确。将具有三种初始孔隙率的YSZ压片和自支撑等离子喷涂涂层分别在干燥空气、水蒸气或干燥氮气中于1300 °C进行热处理。与已有报道中水蒸气对简单氧化物的促进作用相反，水蒸气延缓了微观结构演变。100 h后，孔隙率最高的压片在水蒸气中的晶粒尺寸减小了31%，表观速率常数降至对照值的1/2.8至1/4.2。在同一炉内进行的干燥氮气对照试验中，晶粒尺寸仅变化5.5%，从而分离出水蒸气的影响。涂层同样保留了更高的孔隙率，并在中等暴露时长下具有更低的热导率。DFT计算表明，OH优先结合于晶界处的Y³⁺位点（−2.73 eV）；缺陷平衡敏感性分析预测氧空位减少8–22%。这些结果支持以下机制：OH通过Y³⁺锚定介导晶界稳定化，并改变与空位相关的缺陷，从而延缓烧结。

infographic.key_insight: 水蒸气延缓氧化钇稳定氧化锆中的晶粒长大和烧结，这可能源于OH介导的晶界稳定化。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 考虑水蒸气暴露的影响，有望提高对YSZ热障涂层孔隙率保持情况和隔热性能的预测准确性。
method: 将具有三种初始孔隙率的YSZ压片和自支撑等离子喷涂涂层分别在干燥空气、水蒸气或干燥氮气中于1300 °C进行热处理。
比较晶粒长大、孔隙率和涂层热导率。
采用DFT和缺陷平衡敏感性分析研究OH结合及氧空位变化。
infographic.evidence_signal: 100 h后，孔隙率最高的压片在水蒸气中的晶粒尺寸减小了31%，表观晶粒长大速率常数降至对照值的1/2.8至1/4.2；涂层保留了更高的孔隙率，并在中等暴露时长下具有更低的热导率。
infographic.watch_item: 计算结果支持这一机制，但在所测试的1300 °C暴露条件之外，其在服役条件下的性能仍有待确定。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: For WC–Co–Cr coatings, detonation spraying delivers higher hardness, while HVOF provides a dense, uniform microstructure and low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Powder morphology and spray-process selection can help tailor coatings for machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.
method: Compare detonation-sprayed and HVOF WC–Co–Cr coatings.
Examine powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
Evaluate coating microhardness and tribological behavior.

infographic.watch_item: Test conditions, variability, and quantitative wear rates are not provided in the abstract, limiting application-specific durability conclusions.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF和爆炸喷涂制备WC–Co–Cr涂层的组织形成与耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了比较分析。研究采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散谱（EDS），分析了原始粉末的形貌以及涂层的微观组织和物相组成。结果表明，使用均质、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状组织，且碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆炸喷涂制备的涂层硬度更高（平均显微硬度为1449 HV），而HVOF制备的涂层则具有高致密度、均匀的微观组织和较低的摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。比较分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些研究结果有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，对于剧烈摩擦和高载荷工况下的运行尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: 对于WC–Co–Cr涂层，爆炸喷涂可获得更高的硬度，而HVOF可获得致密、均匀的微观组织和较低的摩擦系数。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 粉末形貌和喷涂工艺的选择有助于针对承受剧烈摩擦和高载荷的机械零件，定制涂层性能。
method: 比较爆炸喷涂和HVOF制备的WC–Co–Cr涂层。

title: Design and Validation of an Automated X-Ray Imaging System for Pipe Weld Inspection
authors: İsmail Ersöz, Ömer Buğra Seymen, Feti Yılmaz, Emre Küçük, Mücahit Soyaslan
abstract: X-ray imaging is widely used for the inspection of welded pipes to detect internal defects such as discontinuities and weld imperfections. In this study, an automated X-ray imaging system capable of performing internal or external inspection depending on pipe diameter was designed and analyzed. Prior to the design stage, a site survey was conducted to determine system layout and material handling conditions, confirming the use of an overhead crane for pipe feeding. Based on process requirements, a modular inspection system was developed for pipes with diameters ranging from 40 mm to 508 mm and lengths between 6 m and 12 m. The pipes are transported by a rail-guided carrier vehicle to a positioning arm equipped with an X-ray tube, where imaging is performed at 25 cm intervals along the weld seam. Accurate alignment of the weld zone with the X-ray tube is achieved using a servo-driven positioning mechanism, providing a positioning accuracy of ±1 mm. A laser sensor is employed for position verification, while an absolute encoder integrated into the servo motor ensures reliable position detection during power interruptions. A height-adjustable mechanism was also designed to maintain proper image alignment on the inspection table. Unlike conventional conceptual inspection setups reported in the literature, the proposed system combines a modular mechanical architecture, servo-assisted positioning, finite element-based structural verification, and experimental validation within a manufacturable industrial inspection platform. Structural analyses revealed maximum stress values of 133.5 MPa in the arm group and 211.1 MPa in the rail vehicle group. Considering the yield strength of AISI 1040 steel, safety factors of 3.1 and 1.96 were obtained, satisfying the requirements of the Machinery Safety Regulation. Simulation results were validated through experimental tests conducted on the manufactured system.

zh-Hans.title: 管道焊缝自动化X射线成像系统的设计与验证
zh-Hans.abstract: X射线成像广泛用于焊接管道检测，以发现不连续性和焊缝缺陷等内部缺陷。本研究设计并分析了一套自动化X射线成像系统，该系统可根据管径从管道内部或外部进行检测。在设计阶段之前，开展了现场勘察，以确定系统布局和物料搬运条件，并确认采用桥式起重机进行管道上料。根据工艺要求，开发了一套模块化检测系统，适用于直径为40 mm至508 mm、长度为6 m至12 m的管道。管道由轨道导向运载车输送至配备X射线管的定位臂处，沿焊缝每隔25 cm进行一次成像。通过伺服驱动定位机构实现焊缝区域与X射线管的精确对准，定位精度为±1 mm。采用激光传感器进行位置校验，同时集成于伺服电机中的绝对值编码器确保断电期间的位置检测可靠性。此外，还设计了高度可调机构，以保持检测台上的图像正确对齐。与文献中报道的常规概念性检测装置不同，所提出的系统在一个可制造的工业检测平台中集成了模块化机械架构、伺服辅助定位、基于有限元的结构校核和实验验证。结构分析表明，臂组件和轨道车组件的最大应力分别为133.5 MPa和211.1 MPa。根据AISI 1040钢的屈服强度，计算得到的安全系数分别为3.1和1.96，满足《机械安全法规》的要求。通过在已制造的系统上开展实验测试，验证了仿真结果。

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理的数字孪生降低空间金属连接中机器人焊接的风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 对空间在轨服务、制造与装配日益增长的兴趣，使模块化建造和在轨维修所需的可靠金属连接技术重新受到关注。机器人焊接具有应用前景，但其在低重力和低压环境下的运行特性仍缺乏充分表征，且接近实际飞行条件的试验有限。英国航天局支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发基于物理的数字孪生，以系统化地降低工艺风险。本文评估了一个基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积法熔池热模型、高斯过程（GP）与神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。该简化模型包含固液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力影响通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不纳入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出边界工况中，80 个求解器响应中的 74 个落在标称 90% 的 GP 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，其中包括缩放处理和预测方差计算。在仿真 UR5 的 L 形焊缝研究中，当焊接行进速度在拐角附近下降时，比例控制器会调整协同式焊接电源的设定值。有限体积法重新评估发现，全部 12 个闭环工作点和 12 个开环工作点中的 9 个均落在示例性的 1.0-3.0 mm 根部侧焊缝宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接工况和控制策略。仍需开展热真空试验、有针对性的低重力试验以及机器人硬件在环研究，以评估模型和控制器。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.engineering_relevance: These models could support welding process optimization by predicting joint strength and hardness before extensive physical testing.
method: Compare multitask neural networks with stacking ensemble learning on a shared welding dataset.
Use shared neural representations with task-specific outputs to predict three mechanical properties.

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测焊接应用中UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习的比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测极限抗拉强度（UTS）、焊道硬度和热影响区（HAZ）机械硬度等焊接性能指标，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其设计目标是用一个模型同时处理多个相互关联的任务。MTL并非为每个任务分别训练模型，而是在任务之间共享表征，使各任务能够利用共同模式，同时保留任务特有的差异。本研究基于同一数据集，比较了多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习这两种先进的机器学习技术在预测上述参数方面的表现。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一类特定的多任务学习（MTL）模型，采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有各自的任务专属输出层。这种共享表征使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保留任务专属输出。研究采用RMSE和R²评估两种方法，以确定其预测精度和整体有效性。其表现出较强的预测能力，UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的RMSE分别为0.1288、0.0886和0.1125，对应的R²值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这表明其能够在相互关联的任务中实现良好的泛化。堆叠集成学习在单项任务的预测精度上优于MTL：UTS的RMSE为0.0263，R²为0.9863；焊缝硬度的RMSE为0.0467，R²为0.9782；HAZ硬度的RMSE为0.1109，R²为0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法能够较好地生成高精度的任务专属预测。这一比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相互关联且数据稀疏的场景，能够实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成方法则在需要高精度、独立预测的情况下表现更好。两种方法均展现出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，可为进一步研究融合二者优势的混合模型奠定基础。

infographic.key_insight: 在预测UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度方面，堆叠集成学习优于多任务神经网络，其中UTS预测的改善幅度最大。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些模型可在开展大量实物试验之前预测接头强度和硬度，从而为焊接工艺优化提供支持。

采用共享神经表征和任务专属输出，预测三项力学性能。
使用RMSE和R²评估预测精度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 堆叠集成学习对UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的预测R²值分别达到0.9863、0.9782和0.8453，而多任务神经网络的对应值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Disk-like droplets with high circularity and expansion promote dense Fe-based amorphous coatings, while lower porosity supports long-term corrosion resistance and higher humidity reduces friction and wear.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Controlling detonation-spray parameters and accounting for service humidity can help tailor protective coatings for Q235 carbon steel.
method: Deposit Fe-based amorphous coatings by detonation spraying under varied parameters.
Examine droplet morphology, lamellar structure, and coating porosity.
Evaluate long-term corrosion and sliding wear under different humidity conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports poorer long-term corrosion resistance with greater porosity and decreasing friction coefficient and wear rate as humidity increases.
infographic.watch_item: Humidity-dependent wear findings involve Si3N4 counterfaces and should not be assumed to generalize to other contact materials.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为及其在不同湿度环境下的磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀与摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展系数，这对于减少涂层缺陷并形成具有致密微观组织的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷越多，其长期耐腐蚀性能越低。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层在不同湿度条件下的磨损行为具有重要影响。随着湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 具有高圆度和高铺展系数的圆盘状液滴有利于形成致密的铁基非晶涂层，而较低的孔隙率有利于长期耐腐蚀性能，较高的湿度则可降低摩擦和磨损。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制爆炸喷涂参数并考虑服役环境湿度，有助于针对Q235碳钢的需求调控防护涂层。

表征液滴形貌、层片结构和涂层孔隙率。
评估长期腐蚀行为以及不同湿度条件下的滑动磨损行为。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比值（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调整为1.0、1.1和1.2。使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数。对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。提高O₂/C₂H₂比值使涂层组织更加致密，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，结合强度则从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa提高至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。在O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得了最高平均显微硬度1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，以及最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织与力学特性的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 提高O₂/C₂H₂比值可改善涂层的致密性、平滑度和结合强度，而显微硬度在中间比值1.1时达到峰值。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制O₂/C₂H₂比值为调控AISI 321钢上Ni–Cr–B–Si涂层的性能提供了一种实用方法。
method: 使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统，在O₂/C₂H₂比值分别为1.0、1.1和1.2的条件下，通过火焰喷涂制备Ni–Cr–B–Si涂层。
使用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂条件。
评估微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 当比值从1.0增至1.2时，孔隙率从1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%，粗糙度从4.70 ± 0.09 µm降至2.99 ± 0.11 µm，结合强度从22.14 ± 4.3 MPa提高至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa；在比值为1.1时，平均显微硬度达到峰值1051.7 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要仅报告了三种气体比值，未报告长期服役试验，因此优选设置取决于目标性能和运行条件。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone-implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti-HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti-HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

infographic.key_insight: Distal weight-bearing implant performance depends on jointly designing load transfer, surface architecture, and bone–implant integration rather than optimizing coatings or geometry alone.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Implant development should couple gait-informed mechanical design with fatigue-resistant, biologically compatible interfaces and coating-integrity testing.
method: Systematic review of implant geometry, biomaterials, and clinical translation.
Synthesis of gait-phase finite element modeling and graded Ti–hydroxyapatite interfaces.
Quantitative trend analysis of evidence maturity and validation depth.
infographic.evidence_signal: The review analyzed 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies, with more than half of empirical evidence remaining at bench or simulation level.
infographic.watch_item: Graded Ti–hydroxyapatite concepts rely predominantly on non-DWBI analog studies, so their promise should not be mistaken for device-specific validation.
infographic.paper_title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation

zh-Hans.title: 远端承重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面及临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端承重植入物（DWBIs）是一类正在临床中兴起的承重医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面结构与生物力学性能紧密耦合。其成功不仅取决于能否在经股截肢康复中恢复远端支撑，还取决于金属、陶瓷及复合生物材料界面能否承受循环载荷，同时促进持久的骨–植入物整合。然而，远端支撑也会改变骨–植入物界面处的弯矩、剪切应力、微动、涂层耐久性及生物学需求。本系统综述综合梳理了DWBI概念、几何优化、采用步态时相载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（FGMs）、梯度Ti-HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据及临床转化路径。对34篇直接贡献文献和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估研究趋势、验证深度及转化就绪程度。然而，超过半数的实证证据仍停留在台架试验或仿真层面，而动物及人体/临床研究构成的验证层规模较小。以HAp为核心的表面或块体材料工程在所纳入文献中占据相当大比例；然而，梯度Ti-HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI生物材料研究及机制类比研究，支持的是机制合理性，而非针对DWBI的特异性验证。从机制上看，DWBI应被视为一个整合的生物材料–力学系统，将宏观几何结构、金属/陶瓷表面结构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态时相载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定及临床工作流程联系起来。实现转化将需要符合患者实际情况的载荷条件、经过验证的有限元分析流程、器械层面的疲劳与涂层完整性测试、标准化的体内终点指标、协调一致的康复方案，以及由登记系统支持的临床随访，从而将力学合理性与持久的生物学固定及患者层面的获益联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 远端承重植入物的性能取决于对载荷传递、表面结构及骨–植入物整合进行协同设计，而非仅优化涂层或几何结构。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 植入物开发应将基于步态信息的力学设计与抗疲劳、具有生物相容性的界面及涂层完整性测试相结合。
method: 对植入物几何结构、生物材料及临床转化进行系统综述。
综合梳理步态时相有限元建模及梯度Ti–羟基磷灰石界面。
对证据成熟度与验证深度进行定量趋势分析。
infographic.evidence_signal: 该综述分析了34篇直接贡献文献和32项实证研究，其中超过半数的实证证据仍停留在台架试验或仿真层面。
infographic.watch_item: 梯度Ti–羟基磷灰石概念主要依赖非DWBI类比研究，因此不应将其潜力误认为针对该类器械的特异性验证。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: Drilled-to-bossed geometry improved AA2024-T351 friction-weld strength, while an ensemble residual network predicted ultimate tensile strength with R² ≈ 0.81.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Combining mechanical interlocking with process optimization could improve high-strength aluminium joints for aerospace and automotive applications.
method: Tested direct drive friction welding on a customized engine lathe using an L18 orthogonal array.
Varied friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying geometry, and friction time.
Compared ensemble residual, compact attention, and adaptive multiscale networks for tensile-strength prediction.
infographic.evidence_signal: The reported optimum—30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min friction time—achieved 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify prediction-validation procedures or independent test data, leaving model generalization uncertain.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 采用钻孔-凸台配合几何结构与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 航空航天和汽车行业对轻质高强材料的需求日益增长，使AA2024-T351等铝合金因其优异的强度重量比而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中获得可靠接头仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究重点优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。受传统榫卯接头启发，研究引入了一种新型钻孔-凸台配合几何结构，以增强机械互锁并提高焊接接头的完整性。采用L18正交表系统设计试验，以评估抗拉强度和抗扭强度。试验在一台定制改装的普通车床上进行，选取摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何结构和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。同时，采用集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络等先进深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，由30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔-凸台配合几何结构和4 min摩擦时间构成的最优参数组合获得了优异的力学性能，抗拉强度达到538 MPa，抗扭强度达到325 MPa。与传统平面-平面接头相比，钻孔-凸台配合结构的接头强度显著更高。此外，在所用深度学习模型中，集成残差网络的预测精度最高，R²值约为0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊接强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 钻孔-凸台配合几何结构提高了AA2024-T351摩擦焊接头的强度，而集成残差网络对极限抗拉强度的预测达到R² ≈ 0.81。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 将机械互锁与工艺优化相结合，有望改善用于航空航天和汽车领域的高强铝合金接头。
method: 采用L18正交表，在定制改装的普通车床上开展直接驱动摩擦焊试验。
改变摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何结构和摩擦时间。
比较集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络在抗拉强度预测中的表现。
infographic.evidence_signal: 所报告的最优条件为30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔-凸台配合几何结构和4 min摩擦时间，在此条件下抗拉强度达到538 MPa，抗扭强度达到325 MPa。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未明确说明预测验证程序或独立测试数据，因此模型的泛化能力仍不确定。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium dioxide–based metal-ceramic coatings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide process settings to target coating geometry and maximize hydrophobicity.
method: Vary detonation-spraying conditions, including nozzle passage speed and spray distance.
Characterize coating roughness, thickness, and water contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify settings for maximum hydrophobicity.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle passage speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical parameter ranges or prediction errors, so the equations require validation before transfer to other spraying setups.
infographic.paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂制备的钛基涂层的表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性能随爆炸喷涂条件的变化关系。研究发现，通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定值，可以在制备过程中控制表面粗糙度、涂层厚度及其疏水性等性能。确定了可使所制备涂层达到最大疏水性的爆炸喷涂工艺参数最优值。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度与喷嘴移动速度之间呈负幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角随喷涂距离的变化遵循抛物线规律。获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，以及确定可使涂层达到最佳疏水性的最优喷涂工况。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂参数可用于调控二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的粗糙度、厚度和疏水性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 所报告的关系可为工艺参数设置提供指导，以获得目标涂层几何特征并最大化疏水性。
method: 改变爆炸喷涂条件，包括喷嘴移动速度和喷涂距离。
表征涂层粗糙度、厚度和水接触角。
推导预测方程，并确定使疏水性最大化的参数设置。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，喷嘴移动速度与粗糙度及厚度之间呈负幂律关系，喷涂距离与粗糙度及接触角之间呈抛物线关系。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供具体的参数数值范围或预测误差，因此，将这些方程应用于其他喷涂装置前需要进行验证。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: UNSM-treated Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings showed sample-dependent hardness, with different treatment settings producing the highest values for detonation-sprayed and HVOF deposits.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Treatment selection should consider both local hardness and surface integrity rather than assuming one UNSM setting suits both deposition routes.
method: Evaluate four UNSM-treated samples per deposition route using static loads of 20 or 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 or 30 µm.
Measure instrumental hardness at 300 mN with a 10 s dwell.
Inspect post-scratch surfaces using SEM.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness ranged from 820–970 HV for detonation-sprayed coatings and 546–1165 HV for HVOF coatings, with maxima at 20 N/20 µm and 30 N/30 µm, respectively.
infographic.watch_item: Post-scratch SEM observations neither isolate UNSM-induced damage nor establish a scratch-resistance ranking.
infographic.paper_title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 研究了经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的硬度与划痕后表面形貌。每种沉积工艺均评估了四个处理样品，采用的静载荷为20和30 N，振动振幅为20和30 µm。在300 mN载荷、10 s保载时间下测量仪器化硬度。DS样品的硬度为820–970 HV，而HVOF样品的硬度范围更宽，为546–1165 HV。DS样品中的最高值出现在以20 N/20 µm处理的DS-T1样品上，HVOF样品中的最高值出现在以30 N/30 µm处理的HVOF-T4样品上。划痕试验后获取的SEM视场显示，两组涂层均存在不均匀的表面对比度和裂纹状不连续特征。这些观察结果为试验后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但无法单独辨别由UNSM引起的损伤，也无法确定抗划伤性能的排序。六个处理样品的可用平均摩擦系数作为补充观察结果予以报告。结果表明，硬度响应因样品而异，并强调需要结合表面完整性评估局部力学性能。

infographic.key_insight: 经UNSM处理的Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层表现出因样品而异的硬度，爆炸喷涂涂层与HVOF涂层分别在不同处理参数下获得最高硬度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 选择处理参数时应同时考虑局部硬度和表面完整性，而不应假定同一组UNSM参数适用于两种沉积工艺。
method: 对每种沉积工艺的四个UNSM处理样品进行评估，采用20或30 N的静载荷以及20或30 µm的振动振幅。
在300 mN载荷、10 s保载时间下测量仪器化硬度。
使用SEM观察划痕后的表面。
infographic.evidence_signal: 爆炸喷涂涂层的硬度范围为820–970 HV，HVOF涂层为546–1165 HV，最高值分别出现在20 N/20 µm和30 N/30 µm处理条件下。
infographic.watch_item: 划痕后的SEM观察既无法单独辨别UNSM引起的损伤，也无法确定抗划伤性能的排序。

title: STUDY OF TRIBOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF BIOCOATINGS BY DETONATION SPRAYING METHOD
authors: Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина, Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Akbar S. Alibekov
abstract: In this study, bioactive hydroxyapatite coatings were deposited on commercially pure Grade 2 titanium substrates by detonation spraying at different O₂/C₂H₂ ratios in the range of 2.6-3.7. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed the predominance of the hydroxyapatite phase with partial formation of α-tricalcium phosphate, which is attributed to high temperatures and intense dynamic processes in the detonation jet. The formed coatings exhibit pronounced hydrophobicity, high structural heterogeneity, and a well-developed surface microrelief, promoting improved interaction with bone tissue and accelerated osseointegration. Tribological tests conducted under dry conditions and in Ringer’s solution demonstrated a significant increase in wear resistance compared to uncoated Grade 2 titanium. The best friction characteristics and the lowest wear volume were observed for coatings deposited at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 3.0 and 3.3, which is associated with an optimal combination of crystallinity, phase composition, and adhesion strength. Coatings formed under these conditions provide stable tribological behavior in physiological environments. The obtained results confirm the prospects of detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite for improving the durability, biocompatibility, and operational reliability of titanium implants.
venue: Bulletin of Shakarim University Technical Sciences

zh-Hans.title: 爆炸喷涂法制备生物涂层的摩擦学性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用爆炸喷涂法，在2.6–3.7范围内的不同O₂/C₂H₂比下，将生物活性羟基磷灰石涂层沉积于Grade 2工业纯钛基体上。X射线衍射分析证实，涂层以羟基磷灰石相为主，并有部分α-磷酸三钙形成，这归因于爆炸射流中的高温和强烈的动态过程。所形成的涂层表现出显著的疏水性、高度的结构非均匀性以及发育充分的表面微观起伏，有助于改善其与骨组织的相互作用并加速骨整合。在干燥条件和林格氏液中进行的摩擦学试验表明，与未涂覆的Grade 2钛相比，涂层的耐磨性显著提高。在O₂/C₂H₂比为3.0和3.3时沉积的涂层具有最佳的摩擦特性和最低的磨损体积，这与结晶度、相组成和结合强度的优化组合有关。在这些条件下形成的涂层在生理环境中表现出稳定的摩擦学行为。所得结果证实，爆炸喷涂羟基磷灰石在提高钛植入物的耐久性、生物相容性和使用可靠性方面具有应用前景。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂羟基磷灰石涂层提高了钛的耐磨性，其中O₂/C₂H₂比为3.0和3.3时的摩擦学性能最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂气体比例可能提高涂层钛植入物在生理条件下的耐久性。
method: 在O₂/C₂H₂比为2.6–3.7的条件下，将羟基磷灰石沉积于Grade 2钛上。
采用X射线衍射表征涂层的物相。
在干燥条件和林格氏液中评估摩擦与磨损性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，涂层以羟基磷灰石为主，并有部分α-磷酸三钙形成；与未涂覆的钛相比，耐磨性有所提高；在比例为3.0和3.3时，磨损体积最低。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供磨损结果的具体数值或生物学验证，因此骨整合的改善仍未得到证实。
